name: Ample Chunk-Peeling Width
definition: For an ample class $C$, take the least $k$ for which $C$ can be reduced to the empty class by repeatedly deleting at most $k$ concepts while leaving an ample class after every deletion.
normalization: $\chi(\varnothing)=0$; deleting all concepts in one step shows $\chi(C)\le |C|$ for every nonempty ample class.
comments: This invariant imposes no orientation. Always $\chi(C)\le\nu(C)$, and both widths have the same zero-level class: $\chi(C)=\nu(C)=1$ exactly for nonempty dismantlable ample classes.
